description: Use for follow-up questions about an already identified attachment: inspect a layer by subject_ref, search or page through all operations, inspect findings, rank improvement investigations, inspect encoded activation fusion, compare source-pinned static delegate eligibility, or explicitly analyze weight distributions, channels, similarity, singular spectra, sparsity and quantization with section=weights and optional weight_view. Weight analysis reads payloads on demand with explicit decoder/budget coverage (128 MiB widget limit). Reuse the ChatGPT-authorized file and the exact SHA-256 from its previous DEEPBOM result. section=profiles lists available backend profiles; query.target selects only a TFLite CPU planning profile from capabilities. The browser computes the query from the shared Evidence IR and returns a bounded result; model bytes are not sent to DEEPBOM. Static candidate eligibility is not observed placement, speed, accuracy, or runtime fusion. Do not invent findings while browser_query_started is pending.

analysis_depth.description: Use structure unless the user explicitly asks to inspect serialized tensor payload values. Payload integrity can require reading the complete attachment.

profile_ids.description: Exact static backend profile IDs returned by section=profiles. Independent eligibility profiles, not runtime assignments.

search.description: Literal case-insensitive filter over row names and references.

source_index.description: Native serialized operator index, not display order. Ambiguous indices require subject_ref.

subject_ref.description: Exact Model IR subject_ref from a previous result; preferred over an index.

target.description: Optional TFLite CPU planning profile ID from capabilities. Not detected hardware or a GPU delegate selector.

weight_view.description: Only for section=weights: explicitly opt into bounded payload analysis; use returned weight subject_ref to select a tensor. Default distribution.
